- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Historical sites include the Twyfelfontein rock engravings, believed to date back to between 2,000 and 6,000 years ago, and the ghost town of Kolmanskop, which provides insights into the diamond mining history of Namibia.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Namibian cuisine is a blend of African, German, and South African influences.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Traditional Namibian dishes include:
  1. Braaivleis (barbecue) - grilled meat, especially beef and game.
  2. Pap and Wors (maize meal and sausage) - a popular breakfast dish.
  3. Oshifima and Oshikundu - traditional staple food of the Ovambo people.
  4. Potjiekos (stew) - slow-cooked stew made with meat, vegetables, and spices.
  5. Kapana - popular street food made from grilled or barbecued beef.
  6. Biltong - dried meat, often made with game meats.
  7. Mopane Worms - roasted or dried caterpillars, considered a delicacy.
